children: Australia's tepid economic performance is likely to be confirmed in 2Q GDP data at 0130 GMT. Economists expect something close 0.3% quarterly growth with the annual rate coming in at 1.8%. Kristina Clifton, economist at CBA says money markets are likely to continue pricing further interest rate increases even if the weak growth is confirmed. Inflation remains uncomfortably high. It would take a big downside surprise of something like a contraction in activity of 0.2% to force a reassessment of the interest rates outlook, she adds. (james.glynn@wsj.com; X @JamesGlynnWSJ)
